title: Plateau-triggered trace repair on pen spinning: event-selected vs uniform keyframes, with a no-trace arm
hypothesis: On Stage-3 pen spinning, where the expert succeeds only through state feedback (D-037), keyframes concentrated around changes in expert actions and pen angular velocity teach a whole-controller edit corrective structure better than uniformly spaced keyframes of the same traces at equal context; both trace arms are also scored against a no-trace continuation so the keyframe contrast is interpretable.

prediction.against: uniform-keyframe plateau-triggered repair (same prefix, traces, fields and keyframe count)
prediction.rationale: Primary: event arm minus uniform arm, fresh 30-case sustained success of each arm's final incumbent, paired by block over four blocks; mean >= +0.20 with a paired t interval above zero. Secondary, reported but not the prediction: each trace arm minus the no-trace arm, the pen-spin transfer of D-033.

code_changes: Isaac backend (lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/pipeline_backend.py): an evaluator that evaluate_manifest dispatches to when the env is an Isaac pen-spin backend. Every evaluation of one policy on one manifest (each search setting's probe, each screen, promotion, fresh evaluation, the demonstration collection and every parity cell) runs in its own fresh Isaac process (D-034): the orchestrator, in its usual Python, writes the policy source, state dict and manifest path to a request file and runs the Isaac child, which builds the policy, runs PenSpinBatchRunner with batch = manifest size, and returns per-episode rows. Episodes are judged by the frozen D-034 sustained reducer at Stage 3; success_rate, per-episode success and a continuous progress term (tail-hit fraction, used only where the pipeline ranks by progress) go into the ordinary ManifestResult, so screening, records and strict promotion are unchanged.

Observation schema 'IsaacPenSpin-stage3' in lares/core/obs_schema.py from cases.OBS_LAYOUT (157-d, named fields: hand_dof_pos, hand_dof_vel, obj_pos, obj_rot, obj_linvel, obj_angvel (x0.2), in_hand_pos, goal_rot, rel_rot, fingertip_pos/rot/vel, last_action; required fields obj_pos, obj_rot, obj_angvel, hand_dof_pos). Generated policies are SymbolicPolicy with action_dim 20; the executed action is the policy mean clamped to [-1, 1], the env's normalised joint-target interface (no action_space.high scaling). A task prompt block names the actuated joint order and the neutral action, and states the per-step success predicate and the sustained episode rule.

Config config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml (run_full_evolution's own schema; config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml stays the env/evaluator protocol file and is referenced, not reused, because run_full_evolution reads a different top-level schema). Plateau plan as R-037: two structure slots, slot 0 a searched single-phase exploration (24 rollout-search settings on the block's 4-case probe manifest), screen = development cases 0-9, promotion = development cases 10-39 under the unchanged strict paired rule, no fitting (bc_steps 0), gpt-6.1-sol, reasoning_effort high, temperature 1, one linked validity correction per slot.

Fork point: the orchestrator writes the full state after slot 0 (records, incumbent, trigger, prefix candidate, search results, ledger) to gen_0/prefix_state.json, and --continue-from <prefix dir> --arm <no_trace|uniform|event> runs slot 1 only from that state, so the three arms of a block share one prefix and one pre-fork incumbent. Arms run in order no_trace, uniform, event; their order cannot affect outcomes because each arm's rollouts are separate processes and its generation call sees only the prefix and its own packet.

Pre-fork incumbent and gate: the shared incumbent is the null 0.00 baseline unless the prefix passes strict promotion, in which case it is the prefix and the block has no plateau (inconclusive for that block; no fork). The trigger fires only if all 24 search settings score zero probe successes and the prefix was not promoted. The edited candidate is the prefix candidate's selected setting (search selected_index; with all-zero probe success the rollout_search tie rule picks by progress, then the earlier index), deterministic. No easier parent is substituted; a block without a plateau parent counts as missing.

Arms: no_trace = slot 1 is another searched single-phase exploration (as the R-037 repair-off runs). uniform and event = one whole-controller edit of the edited candidate with the same request text, the same two traces (first two sustained-success expert episodes in manifest order on the shared 10-case demonstration manifest, seed 4124; qualification gate >= 9/10 sustained or the study stops inconclusive before any trace arm), the same fields per row, the same rounding and exactly 16 keyframes per trace; then searched like an exploration (24 settings on the probe), screened, and challenged under strict promotion. An invalid or rejected edit leaves the shared incumbent in place.

Keyframe rule, frozen before any outcome: L = trace length; endpoints t=0 and t=L-1 are always kept. Uniform: t_k = round(k (L-1) / 15), k = 0..15. Event: for interior t in [1, L-2], s_t = ||a_t - a_{t-1}||_2 / m_a + ||w_t - w_{t-1}||_2 / m_w, where a is the executed 20-d action, w the pen's world angular velocity in rad/s (obs obj_angvel / 0.2), and m_a, m_w the medians over t = 1..L-1 of the same trace's step-to-step norms (weights 1:1; a zero median is replaced by 1). Frames are taken greedily in descending s_t, ties to the earlier t, skipping any frame within 6 steps of one already kept (endpoints included), until 16 are kept; selected frames are listed in time order.

Row rendering (identical in both arms): t, pen centre offset from in_hand_pos (3, m, 4 dp), pen long axis in world (3, 3 dp), pen angular velocity (3, rad/s, 2 dp), signed roll rate about the pen axis (rad/s, 2 dp), the 24 hand joint positions (rad, 3 dp) and the 20 executed actions (3 dp). The request states which fields are state and which are actions, and that the expert is closed-loop (D-037). Character and token counts of both packets are recorded; both arms carry 32 rows of identical fields.

Live parity gate before any LLM call (88 episodes on fresh seed 4137, reserved for the parity gate only; 30 cases, batches are its first 4, first 10 and all 30 cases): the D-036 expert through the new backend vs through protocols.run_cell, separate processes, at batch sizes 4, 10 and 30 (44 episodes per backend): zero sustained-outcome flips and at most floor(batch/10) diverged environments per size; abort on failure.

Mocked integration tests (no Isaac, no API key) before any live spend: request/response round trip of the backend with a fake child; reset and previous-action isolation (the child zeroes last_action, D-034); schema slices equal cases.OBS_LAYOUT; executed-action clamp and joint order; the sustained reducer on the returned rows; records validate; strict promotion and the null incumbent; the fork state round-trips; both keyframe rules on synthetic traces (counts, endpoints, spacing, tie rule).

Fresh evaluation: after a block's three arms finish, each arm's final incumbent is scored on the block's 30-case fresh manifest (seeds 4133-4136) in its own process. A null incumbent has no policy and scores 0/30 by the pipeline's NULL_INCUMBENT_ID definition (no episodes run); any promoted policy is evaluated, never assumed.

Episode ledger per block: prefix slot 146 (zero-shot screen 10 + 24 x 4 probe + selected screen 10 + promotion 30), three continuation slots 146 each (438), fresh 3 x 30 = 90: 674. Four blocks 2696, demonstrations 10 (once), parity 88: 2794. An interrupted demonstration collection stops the study as inconclusive; it is never rerun on the same cases. LLM calls: at most 2 per slot (one generation + one linked correction), 4 slots per block, 4 blocks = 32. About 450 Isaac processes; wall time measured, about 6-8 h on the T4.

Analysis: block-paired differences of fresh incumbent success (event - uniform primary; uniform - no_trace and event - no_trace secondary), Student t over the eligible blocks; blocks without a plateau parent are reported and excluded; fewer than 3 eligible blocks makes the comparison inconclusive. Episodes are never pooled as independent search replicates.

falsified_by: Across the eligible plateau blocks (at least 3 of 4), the paired interval of event minus uniform fresh success has an upper bound below +0.20. Fewer than 3 eligible blocks, a failed parity gate, or an unqualified demonstration manifest makes it inconclusive.

approval.note: This tests whether corrective-event keyframes improve Stage-3 plateau repair beyond uniform sampling, with the no-trace arm checking whether repair transfers beyond MetaWorld. I accept the implementer's fresh parity seed 4137, removal of demonstration reruns, and corrected maximum cost of 2794 simul

accounting.note: unique calls/tokens: the four prefix calls (tokens 17774, 11041, 11612, 14043) are copied into each arm's ledger and counted once here; per-arm lists in per_arm_development include the copied prefix call

controls.baseline: uniform-keyframe plateau-triggered repair arm (same prefix copy, same two expert traces demo-0000/demo-0001, same fields and 16 keyframes per trace), fresh 30-case sustained success per block; secondary control the no-trace arm (one more searched single-phase exploration)

result.notes: Floor result. All four blocks fired the plateau trigger (0/4 probe successes on all 24 prefix search settings, no promotion) and all twelve continuation arms ended with the null incumbent, so every fresh score is 0 by definition (no fresh episode run) and every contrast, primary event-uniform and both secondary, is exactly 0.000 [0,0]. The prediction (event-uniform >= +0.20) is not met; with all arms at the floor the experiment cannot rank the keyframe rules. Development evidence: promotion-set sustained successes no_trace 2/120 (block 0, 0.067), uniform 0/120, event 1/120 (block 3); screen successes no_trace 1/40, uniform 0/40, event 1/40. Dropping the pen dominates trace-arm failures in blocks 0-1 (uniform 30/30 and 28/30 dropped) while those candidates have the highest tail-hit fractions (0.40, 0.335): they spin while they hold, then lose the pen. Exploratory promotion-set tail-hit contrasts are not significant. Demonstrations 10/10; parity 0 flips at batches 4/10/30. Trace arms cost about 2.5-3x the tokens of the no-trace arm for one call (the 31k-char request). The two expert traces carry 20-d joint targets at 16 keyframes, which a symbolic controller of 6-10 parameters cannot reproduce; the expert's success is in its feedback map (D-037), which keyframes sample sparsely.

verdicts.reasoning: The predeclared primary, event minus uniform fresh sustained success paired over four blocks, is exactly 0.000 with a degenerate [0,0] interval; the protocol's conclusiveness rule (>=3 eligible blocks) is met with 4/4 triggers fired, and the interval excludes the predicted +0.20, so the prediction as stated is refuted. The caveat is a floor: all twelve continuation arms ended with the null incumbent, so the study cannot rank keyframe rules at any effect size it could detect and does not show trace repair is useless in general. Development evidence agrees there is no trace benefit: promotion-set successes no_trace 2/120, uniform 0/120, event 1/120; exploratory tail-hit contrasts event-uniform -0.047 [-0.195,+0.102], uniform-no_trace +0.079 [-0.088,+0.245]. Trace-arm candidates in blocks 0-1 spin while held (highest tail-hit 0.40, 0.335) but drop the pen in 28-30 of 30 promotion cases, consistent with D-037: the expert's competence is its feedback map, which 32 sparse state-action keyframes from 2 episodes do not convey to a 6-10 parameter controller. Demonstrations 10/10 and parity 0 flips, so the null is not an integration fault.
verdicts.next_experiment: Stage 3 is at the floor for single-step symbolic exploration; next test a dense, fitted use of the expert (e.g. parameter fitting of the edited controller to expert state-action pairs, rollout-selected) or move the repair study to Stage 1/2 where generated controllers have non-zero base rates, so a trace effect is measurable.

verdicts.reasoning: All four blocks were eligible, the parity gate passed, and demonstrations qualified at 10/10 sustained successes [logs/pen_spin/r042_keyframe_repair/summary.json]. The primary event-minus-uniform paired_success_difference was 0.000 with reported 95% interval [0.000, 0.000], whose upper bound is below the predeclared +0.20 falsification threshold [logs/pen_spin/r042_keyframe_repair/summary.json]. Every arm retained a null incumbent, so fresh success was assigned zero under the approved null-incumbent convention, with no fresh simulator episodes; the named uniform control was therefore accounted for rather than missing [logs/pen_spin/r042_keyframe_repair/summary.json]. This refutes the predicted final-incumbent improvement under this protocol, but the shared floor does not establish equivalence of the keyframe rules or distinguish their mechanisms [logs/pen_spin/r042_keyframe_repair/summary.json]. Secondary success contrasts also tied, and every exploratory tail-hit contrast interval included zero, providing no evidence of a trace-repair advantage [logs/pen_spin/r042_keyframe_repair/summary.json].

history.note: pre-launch reconciliation (advisor consult call_00085 accepted all four as implementation reconciliations): (1) the orchestrator runs in the pipeline venv (.venv-metaworld, which has openai; installing it into the box's ~/IsaacLab env would modify that checkout) and every rollout is a fresh child that sources Isaac's env; command updated accordingly. (2) trace rows show hand_dof_pos as the policy observes it, labelled normalised [-1, 1], not radians. (3) the repair request lists the parameter values the prefix's rollout search selected for the edited candidate. (4) the request states D-037 precisely: one recorded tape replayed open loop succeeded 0/40 vs 40/40 closed loop. All four apply identically to the uniform and event arms; no-trace contrasts are read as repair-package effects. Seeds 4120-4137 were reserved in the ledger on 2026-10-27 before any rollout; only their manifests were built (pure numpy), no episode or LLM call has used them, so protocol.seeds is empty and protocol.manifests names the 13 frozen files plus the parity manifest (R-037/R-040 precedent). Validation before launch: 21-test mocked end-to-end gate (tests/test_pen_spin_pipeline.py), full suite on the box (866+41+116), and a live backend smoke on spent debug seed 4097 only.

direction: Continue researching the single-step exploration pipeline with plateau-triggered trace repair, extended to pen spinning on the Shadow Hand (Isaac Lab Isaac-ShadowHandSpin-Stage{1,2,3}-Direct-v0, vendored in lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin; 157-d full obs, 20-d action, 60 Hz, 360-step episodes). Expert demonstrations: first try a hand-written scripted spinning controller; also search online for an existing trained pen-spinning policy; if neither qualifies, train an RL expert (rsl_rl PPO on the box). No budget ceiling on GPU hours or LLM calls. Known gaps to turn into questions: the env's spin_rate is roll about the pen's own long axis (not end-over-end twirl), success is per step with no episode rule, and the pipeline (manifests, obs schema, runner, records) is MetaWorld-only today. Debug issues, improve the pipeline, and turn unexpected findings into concrete research questions; document results and limitations.

advisor.reasoning: This tests a genuinely new mechanism—trace selection under matched context—not the already-decided trace-versus-summary comparison, and directly advances the requested pipeline extension. The proposed 1162 episodes and at most 24 LLM calls are worthwhile only after production rollouts obey the known process-isolation requirement; currently that requirement is explicit only for backend checks. Event scoring and pre-fork incumbent accounting also need executable definitions before spending. Retain paired_success_difference increasing by at least 0.20 against uniform-keyframe repair, with the declared upper-bound-below-0.20 falsifier and missing plateau parents or zero-crossing intervals inconclusive.
suggested_changes: Require a fresh Isaac process for every rollout batch, including each parameter setting, demonstration collection, screen, promotion evaluation and fresh evaluation—not just parity checks.

Freeze the event score's normalization reference, norms, weights, tie-breaking and frame-selection procedure before outcome inspection; specify how endpoints, six-step spacing and exactly 16 frames are reconciled. Freeze rendering so both arms retain the same fields and complete-frame count under the common token ceiling.

Specify the shared pre-fork incumbent, deterministic selection among zero-success parameter settings, and promotion sequence. Evaluate the incumbent rather than assuming zero success, never install a generated parent without strict promotion, and retain the shared incumbent when an edit is invalid or rejected.

Reuse scripts/run_full_evolution.py and config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml, adding only the missing Isaac adapter. Before live spend, add mocked integration checks for reset/previous-action isolation, observation/action conventions, the frozen reducer, records and strict promotion; retain the 88-episode live parity gate before LLM calls.

Reconcile the episode ledger with the explicit incumbent and prefix-selection protocol; retain 1162 episodes and 24 calls only if all required evaluations and validity corrections fit those caps, otherwise submit corrected costs.

implementer.reasoning: Agree with revise and every listed change (process per rollout batch, frozen event score, explicit incumbent accounting, mocked integration checks, reconciled costs). One addition I will put in the revision: a third, no-trace arm (slot 1 = another searched exploration, as in the R-037 repair-off runs) in the same blocks. The user's direction is to evaluate plateau-triggered trace repair on pen spinning; D-030 to D-033 established trace-vs-no-trace on MetaWorld only, never on a 20-d dexterous task with a learned expert, so the keyframe comparison is uninterpretable if neither repair arm beats no repair. The no-trace arm reuses the same prefix and incumbent, so it adds one generation call and its screen/promotion/fresh episodes per block, not a new prefix.

advisor.reasoning: This would test whether correction-focused keyframes improve plateau repair on a feedback-dependent dexterous task. I accept the implementer's no-trace arm as a valuable transfer baseline, and the separate orchestration config is justified by its different schema. The revised isolation, fork and promotion accounting address the earlier concerns, but the parity gate explicitly reuses spent seed 4097, and the demonstration crash allowance risks another prohibited reuse. Those seed violations prevent approval as written.
suggested_changes: Replace parity seed 4097 with fresh seed 4137, absent from the briefing's spent list; reserve it in the ledger and add it to the protocol. Preserve the paired backend comparison and the existing 88-episode gate.

Remove the partial demonstration-manifest crash rerun. An interrupted collection must stop this run as inconclusive rather than replay spent cases; any subsequent collection needs a separately agreed fresh-seed protocol.
Update the maximum episode ledger to 2794 (2696 study + 10 demonstrations + 88 parity), retaining at most 32 LLM calls and the existing script/config reuse.

Retain the primary prediction: paired_success_difference increases by at least 0.20 against uniform-keyframe repair, with a paired interval above zero required for evidence of improvement. Retain its falsified_by observation: the eligible-block interval's upper bound is below +0.20; fewer than three eligible blocks or failed qualification/parity gates remain inconclusive.

implementer.reasoning: Agree with all four changes: parity on a fresh seed 4137 (reserved, added to the protocol), no crash rerun (an interrupted demonstration collection stops the study inconclusive), 2794 episodes, 32 calls, primary prediction and falsifier unchanged.

advisor.reasoning: This tests whether corrective-event keyframes improve Stage-3 plateau repair beyond uniform sampling, with the no-trace arm checking whether repair transfers beyond MetaWorld. I accept the implementer's fresh parity seed 4137, removal of demonstration reruns, and corrected maximum cost of 2794 simulator episodes and 32 LLM calls; reuse scripts/run_full_evolution.py and config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml through the justified schema-specific config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml. The weakest point is inference from only four blocks sharing two demonstrations, so conclusions must remain conditional on eligible plateau blocks and this trace packet. Retain the prediction that paired_success_difference increases by at least 0.20 against uniform-keyframe repair, requiring a paired interval above zero for improvement; falsified_by is an eligible-block interval with upper bound below +0.20, while failed gates or fewer than three eligible blocks are inconclusive and ties or zero-crossing intervals do not establish improvement.

implementer.reasoning: Agree. Implementation order: schema and backend with mocked tests, keyframe rules, fork state, config and frozen manifests (seeds reserved before any rollout), parity gate on 4137, then the four blocks. Conclusions conditional on eligible plateau blocks and this two-trace packet.

Fork point: the orchestrator writes the full state after slot 0 (records, incumbent, trigger, prefix candidate, search results, ledger) to gen_0/prefix_state.json, and --continue-from <prefix dir> --arm <no_trace|uniform|event> runs slot 1 only from that state, so the three arms of a block share one prefix and one pre-fork incumbent. Arms run in order no_trace, uniform, event; their order cannot affect outcomes because each arm's rollouts are separate processes and its generation call sees only the prefix and its own packet.

Pre-fork incumbent and gate: the shared incumbent is the null 0.00 baseline unless the prefix passes strict promotion, in which case it is the prefix and the block has no plateau (inconclusive for that block; no fork). The trigger fires only if all 24 search settings score zero probe successes and the prefix was not promoted. The edited candidate is the prefix candidate's selected setting (search selected_index; with all-zero probe success the rollout_search tie rule picks by progress, then the earlier index), deterministic. No easier parent is substituted; a block without a plateau parent counts as missing.

Arms: no_trace = slot 1 is another searched single-phase exploration (as the R-037 repair-off runs). uniform and event = one whole-controller edit of the edited candidate with the same request text, the same two traces (first two sustained-success expert episodes in manifest order on the shared 10-case demonstration manifest, seed 4124; qualification gate >= 9/10 sustained or the study stops inconclusive before any trace arm), the same fields per row, the same rounding and exactly 16 keyframes per trace; then searched like an exploration (24 settings on the probe), screened, and challenged under strict promotion. An invalid or rejected edit leaves the shared incumbent in place.

Keyframe rule, frozen before any outcome: L = trace length; endpoints t=0 and t=L-1 are always kept. Uniform: t_k = round(k (L-1) / 15), k = 0..15. Event: for interior t in [1, L-2], s_t = ||a_t - a_{t-1}||_2 / m_a + ||w_t - w_{t-1}||_2 / m_w, where a is the executed 20-d action, w the pen's world angular velocity in rad/s (obs obj_angvel / 0.2), and m_a, m_w the medians over t = 1..L-1 of the same trace's step-to-step norms (weights 1:1; a zero median is replaced by 1). Frames are taken greedily in descending s_t, ties to the earlier t, skipping any frame within 6 steps of one already kept (endpoints included), until 16 are kept; selected frames are listed in time order.

Row rendering (identical in both arms): t, pen centre offset from in_hand_pos (3, m, 4 dp), pen long axis in world (3, 3 dp), pen angular velocity (3, rad/s, 2 dp), signed roll rate about the pen axis (rad/s, 2 dp), the 24 hand joint positions (rad, 3 dp) and the 20 executed actions (3 dp). The request states which fields are state and which are actions, and that the expert is closed-loop (D-037). Character and token counts of both packets are recorded; both arms carry 32 rows of identical fields.

Live parity gate before any LLM call (88 episodes on fresh seed 4137, reserved for the parity gate only; 30 cases, batches are its first 4, first 10 and all 30 cases): the D-036 expert through the new backend vs through protocols.run_cell, separate processes, at batch sizes 4, 10 and 30 (44 episodes per backend): zero sustained-outcome flips and at most floor(batch/10) diverged environments per size; abort on failure.

Mocked integration tests (no Isaac, no API key) before any live spend: request/response round trip of the backend with a fake child; reset and previous-action isolation (the child zeroes last_action, D-034); schema slices equal cases.OBS_LAYOUT; executed-action clamp and joint order; the sustained reducer on the returned rows; records validate; strict promotion and the null incumbent; the fork state round-trips; both keyframe rules on synthetic traces (counts, endpoints, spacing, tie rule).

Fresh evaluation: after a block's three arms finish, each arm's final incumbent is scored on the block's 30-case fresh manifest (seeds 4133-4136) in its own process. A null incumbent has no policy and scores 0/30 by the pipeline's NULL_INCUMBENT_ID definition (no episodes run); any promoted policy is evaluated, never assumed.

Episode ledger per block: prefix slot 146 (zero-shot screen 10 + 24 x 4 probe + selected screen 10 + promotion 30), three continuation slots 146 each (438), fresh 3 x 30 = 90: 674. Four blocks 2696, demonstrations 10 (once), parity 88: 2794. An interrupted demonstration collection stops the study as inconclusive; it is never rerun on the same cases. LLM calls: at most 2 per slot (one generation + one linked correction), 4 slots per block, 4 blocks = 32. About 450 Isaac processes; wall time measured, about 6-8 h on the T4.

Analysis: block-paired differences of fresh incumbent success (event - uniform primary; uniform - no_trace and event - no_trace secondary), Student t over the eligible blocks; blocks without a plateau parent are reported and excluded; fewer than 3 eligible blocks makes the comparison inconclusive. Episodes are never pooled as independent search replicates.
